title: Seven Deacons Chosen, Stephen Arrested

questions.question: Why did a complaint arise from the Hellenists against the Hebrews in the early church?
options: Their widows were being neglected in the daily distribution
They were excluded from teaching in the synagogues
They were not allowed to serve as elders in the church
Their children were denied baptism by the Hebrew Christians
questions.correctAnswer: Their widows were being neglected in the daily distribution
questions.explanation: Acts 6:1 (ESV): "Now in these days when the disciples were increasing in number, a complaint by the Hellenists arose against the Hebrews because their widows were being neglected in the daily distribution."

questions.question: The twelve called the full number of disciples together and said "It is not right that we should give up preaching the word of God to..." what?
options: serve tables
handle disputes among you
distribute bread and silver
manage the community funds
questions.explanation: Acts 6:2 (ESV): "And the twelve summoned the full number of the disciples and said, 'It is not right that we should give up preaching the word of God to serve tables.'"

questions.question: What qualifications did the apostles require for the seven men to be chosen?
options: Of good repute, full of the Spirit and of wisdom
Widows who had been married once, of good repute
Ordained priests who had served in the temple
At least thirty years old and baptized by John
questions.correctAnswer: Of good repute, full of the Spirit and of wisdom
questions.explanation: Acts 6:3 (ESV): "Therefore, brothers, pick out from among you seven men of good repute, full of the Spirit and of wisdom, whom we will appoint to this duty."

questions.question: Who was the first named among the seven chosen, described as a man full of faith and the Holy Spirit?
options: Stephen
Philip
Prochorus
Nicolas
questions.explanation: Acts 6:5 (ESV): "And what they said pleased the whole gathering, and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit..."

questions.question: What did the apostles do after the seven were chosen?
options: Prayed and laid their hands on them
Anointed them with oil and fasted
Gave them the title of elder in the assembly
Sent them to Jerusalem for further training
questions.correctAnswer: Prayed and laid their hands on them
questions.explanation: Acts 6:6 (ESV): "These they set before the apostles, and they prayed and laid their hands on them."

questions.question: After the seven were appointed, what was the result for the word of God?
options: The word of God continued to increase, and the number of the disciples multiplied greatly in Jerusalem
Signs and wonders increased greatly through the seven men
The Hellenists and Hebrews were fully reconciled in peace
The surrounding synagogues began sending inquirers to them
questions.correctAnswer: The word of God continued to increase, and the number of the disciples multiplied greatly in Jerusalem
questions.explanation: Acts 6:7 (ESV): "And the word of God continued to increase, and the number of the disciples multiplied greatly in Jerusalem, and a great many of the priests became obedient to the faith."

questions.question: An impressive group also came to faith. Who specifically joined the believers, which was remarkable?
options: A great many of the priests
Several members of the Sanhedrin
Many Roman centurions
The family of the high priest Caiaphas
questions.correctAnswer: A great many of the priests
questions.explanation: Acts 6:7 (ESV): "...and a great many of the priests became obedient to the faith."

questions.question: Stephen was doing great wonders and signs. From which synagogue did men rise up to dispute with him?
options: The synagogue of the Freedmen, including Cyrenians, Alexandrians, and those from Cilicia and Asia
The main synagogue of Jerusalem near the temple gate
The synagogue of the Pharisees in the upper city
The synagogue where Gamaliel taught in Jerusalem
questions.correctAnswer: The synagogue of the Freedmen, including Cyrenians, Alexandrians, and those from Cilicia and Asia
questions.explanation: Acts 6:9 (ESV): "Then some of those who belonged to the synagogue of the Freedmen (as it was called), and of the Cyrenians, and of the Alexandrians, and of those from Cilicia and Asia, rose up and disputed with Stephen."

questions.question: They were unable to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit with which Stephen spoke. What did they do instead?
options: Secretly instigated men to say he had spoken blasphemous words against Moses and God
Brought Stephen before the Sanhedrin for formal trial
Wrote a letter to the high priest denouncing Stephen
Organized a public debate to humiliate him before the people
questions.correctAnswer: Secretly instigated men to say he had spoken blasphemous words against Moses and God
questions.explanation: Acts 6:11 (ESV): "Then they secretly instigated men who said, 'We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.'"

questions.question: The false witnesses claimed Stephen had said Jesus would do what to the place and customs Moses had delivered?
options: Destroy the temple and change the customs Moses had delivered
Replace the temple with a building not made with hands
Abolish the Sabbath and all feast days of Israel
Transfer all temple worship to Galilee permanently
questions.correctAnswer: Destroy the temple and change the customs Moses had delivered
questions.explanation: Acts 6:14 (ESV): "for we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place and will change the customs that Moses delivered to us."

questions.question: When Stephan was brought before the Sanhedrin and the high priest asked if the charges were true, what did those sitting in the council notice about Stephen's face?
options: His face was like the face of an angel
He was visibly trembling with righteous anger
Tears of grief streamed down his face
He was radiant with joy and completely unafraid
questions.correctAnswer: His face was like the face of an angel
questions.explanation: Acts 6:15 (ESV): "And gazing at him, all who sat in the council saw that his face was like the face of an angel."

questions.question: The seven were set before the apostles and had hands laid on them. The apostles said they would devote themselves to what two things instead of serving tables?
options: Prayer and to the ministry of the word
Teaching and baptizing new believers
Healing the sick and delivering the oppressed
Evangelism and planting new congregations
questions.correctAnswer: Prayer and to the ministry of the word
questions.explanation: Acts 6:4 (ESV): "But we will devote ourselves to prayer and to the ministry of the word."

questions.question: The last of the seven named was Nicolas. What was distinctive about him?
options: He was a proselyte of Antioch
He was the only one born outside of Judea
He was a former priest now converted to Christ
He was the youngest of the seven by far
questions.correctAnswer: He was a proselyte of Antioch
questions.explanation: Acts 6:5 (ESV): "...and Nicolas, a proselyte of Antioch."

questions.question: Stephen is described as being full of grace and power was doing great wonders among the people. What was his role among the seven?
options: One of the seven appointed to handle the daily distribution
The chief apostle to the Hellenistic Jews
The personal deacon of the apostle Peter
An elder appointed to oversee the Jerusalem church
questions.correctAnswer: One of the seven appointed to handle the daily distribution
questions.explanation: Acts 6:3-5 (ESV): Stephen was first among the seven chosen to serve tables, though he also performed great wonders.

questions.question: They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and seized Stephen and brought him before the council. What were the false charges against him summarized as?
options: Speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law
Claiming Jesus was greater than Caesar and the Roman gods
Teaching people to abandon circumcision and temple sacrifice
Eating with uncircumcised Gentiles and breaking Sabbath law
questions.correctAnswer: Speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law
questions.explanation: Acts 6:13 (ESV): "And they set up false witnesses who said, 'This man never ceases to speak words against this holy place and the law,'"

key_verse_text: "But we will devote ourselves to prayer and to the ministry of the word."
